scope: Three-command development screening; original thresholds preserved; not seven-command acceptance

evaluation.conditions: flat terrain; official play configuration; constant command, head/body command zero; no external pushes; record all remaining randomization
evaluation.linear_xy_error_definition: Mean over time of sqrt((vx-command_vx)^2 + (vy-command_vy)^2), then equal-weight mean across first episodes. Not the mean of x/y component absolute errors.
evaluation.metric_clarification: 2026-11-01 before any formal fixed-command evaluation: use planar vector error so standing still cannot pass the 0.15 m/s forward command at a 0.08 m/s threshold. Initial 2-second preflight component-MAE summaries remain diagnostic and are not acceptance evidence.
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: last checkpoint is primary; intermediate results diagnostic; selected alternative evaluated on heldout seed once and explicitly labeled
